title: Work-tape printing walk
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean input, let $k$ be a gate kind, $c$ a gate code, $pc$ a program counter, and $t$ one of the three work tapes. Suppose the input-head position is $p$, the work tapes are given by $tp$, their head positions by $hd$, and tape $t$ contains the unary encoding of $m$. For every $j\le m$ and every output list $out$, the emitter machine started in its printing state for tape $t$, with that tape's head at $j-1$ and the other heads as in $hd$, reaches after $j+1$ steps its printing state for the same tape and program counter, with that tape's head at zero, the same input-head position and tape contents, and output $out$ followed by $j$ true bits.
hypotheses_covered: tape $t$ in $tp$ equals the unary tape of $m$
